site.name: Overpass
site.promise: The exchange for verified African integrations
site.title: Overpass, the exchange for verified African integrations
site.description: Integration sheets verified by developers, a test track that simulates a mobile money payment without a merchant account, and an MCP server for your coding assistant.

home.title: Home
home.description: Integration sheets verified by developers, a test track that simulates a mobile money payment without a merchant account, and an MCP server for your coding assistant.

routes.title: Itineraries
routes.description: Integration sheets by service, country and stack: the code that works, the known potholes and dated checks by other developers.

sandbox.title: Test track
sandbox.description: Simulate a mobile money payment and its real cases: success, insufficient funds, operator timeout, duplicate or late webhook.

demo.title: Demo
demo.description: Run a simulated payment end to end in under 30 seconds, with no account and no merchant key.

discussions.title: Discussions
discussions.description: Threads open to everything an African developer deals with: integrations, cloud, tools, AI, career and projects.

ranking.title: Ranking
ranking.description: The ranking of the countries and developers who publish, check and improve integration sheets.

simulators.title: Requested simulators
simulators.description: The services the community wants a simulator for, ranked by votes.

blog.title: Blog
blog.description: African tech news, tutorials and portraits, written by the team and by members.

newsletter.title: Newsletter
newsletter.description: A weekly digest of the best sheets, discussions and articles, in French or English.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.description: Connect the MCP server to Claude Code, Cursor or VS Code, and the reference of the simulator API.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.description: Overpass's free plan today, and the Team and Enterprise plans to come. No online payment for now.

about.title: About
about.description: Overpass, built by the Ghostapi team in Côte d'Ivoire for the Systalink Challenge, with open code.

legal.title: Legal notice
legal.description: The publisher, the hosting and the licences of the open source components Overpass uses.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: The data Overpass stores, why, for how long, the session cookie and self-service account deletion.

signUp.title: Sign up
signUp.description: Create your Overpass account with an e-mail address and your country, to publish and check sheets.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Sign in to Overpass to find your sheets, your checks and your MCP tokens.
